attempts.rationale: The series is trend dominated with moderate ranking stability; a weighted inverse-error combination is a natural first try.
The series has moderate ranking stability and strong trend dominance; a robust central tendency like median may reduce influence of outliers in the weighted error.
The series is trend dominated with moderate ranking stability; a trimmed mean might reduce influence of outlier models.
The series has a strong trend and moderate ranking stability; a simple mean of all models might provide a baseline that is different from weighted/median.
Test a weighted combination using the new weight handle w1 to see if a different weighting scheme improves over inverse_error and median.
test a different weighting method (softmax_neg_error) to see if it improves over inverse_error, given the trend-dominated series with moderate ranking stability.
The series is trend dominated with moderate ranking stability; a DBA (data‑driven baseline) might capture trend better than simple weighted.
Test a weighted combination on the reduced, top‑5 pool (trend dominated, moderate ranking stability) to see if focusing on low‑error, diverse models improves SMAPE.
try a weighted combo on the small, strong‑trend pool with softmax weights to see if a different weighting improves over the current median leader.
trend dominated but ranking moderate; try per‑horizon top‑k weighted on full pool to capture horizon shifts.
Test a simple mean over the strong 5‑model pool to see if averaging improves over weighted inverse error on the same pool.

The series is trend dominated with moderate ranking stability; a weighted or simple median over a small, diverse pool (pool4) may improve over the full‑pool median. I will test a median combination on pool4 to see if the reduced model set yields a tighter score.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.2066. Series context: trend strength 0.9834 and seasonal strength 0.0885; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.376); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 53.756.
